top_violation_types.title: HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - Not Listed (26 TAC §HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - No)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Regular care is being provided to 2 unrelated children.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a dog in the backyard without vaccinations record.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were no annual training hours available for viewing.

top_violation_types.title: Additional Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free from Other Activities Not Directly Involving Teaching, Care and Supervision (26 TAC §747.1501(c)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that the caregiver was washing dishes when the child climbed and fell from the coffee table resulting in injury.

top_violation_types.title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Personnel or Hospitalization (26 TAC §747.305(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was an accidental injury where a toddler climbed onto a small table and then fell onto the ground. The caregiver reported that the child appeared to be uninjured and completed an incident report but did not immediately contact and notify the parent. The parent later sought medical treatment for the child.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not conduct a fire drill for the month of August.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.
